item.mekaddon.combining_slot_upgrade.des: Replaces the Combining Factory's single shared secondary slot with one per process.
Run every process with its own secondary ingredient at the same time. One is consumed per machine.
item.mekaddon.combining_slot_upgrade.hin: Install it in the upgrade slot, or Shift + Right-click the machine. Mutually exclusive with the Extra Stack Upgrade.
item.mekaddon.extra_stack_upgrade.desc: Doubles the stack limit of the secondary input slot (the Combining Factory's yellow slot, the stamper's mold slot): x2 per upgrade.
item.mekaddon.extra_stack_upgrade.desc2: Up to 8 of them: x2 / x4 / x8 / x16 / x32 / x64 / x128 / x256.
item.mekaddon.extra_stack_upgrade.hint: Without the Combining Slot Upgrade it enlarges the machine's shared secondary slot. Mutually exclusive with the Combining Slot Upgrade.
upgrade.mekaddon.combining_slots.desc: Gives every process its own secondary input slot.
upgrade.mekaddon.extra_stack.desc: Doubles the stack limit of the secondary input slot per upgrade, up to x256.
